Once the disk was full, InnoDB writes to events.ibd failed with 'No space left on device' (#90, #101), and ingest-api inserts failed with error 1114 'The table is full' (#91, #107). ingest-api's failed inserts propagated as 500s to ingest-gateway (#87, #100, #123, #130), which are downstream symptoms. Reads stay healthy because they don't write. Enrichment, geo-cache and event-processor logged no errors, which fits a write-path-only failure at the database. Afterwards, add disk-usage alerting well before 95%, and set binlog retention/expiry so WAL growth cannot fill the volume. Check whether the growth rate (~835MB/h) came from a recent change in event volume or in retention settings.
